requiredChecks: Compare the royal prologue and modern awakening against original source footage.
Verify whether the target episode begins before or after the doctor/date exchange.

transitionRecommendations.direct: Preferred if the episode continues the modern bedside dialogue; cut after the reincarnation montage and on a stable exchange around 21-25s, subject to frame/audio review.
transitionRecommendations.A: If the episode begins with the royal attack, preserve the sword beat and transition on the fall/rebirth image.
transitionRecommendations.B: If the episode begins later in the modern household, retain the date reveal as a recap bridge, then dissolve/cut into the first matching modern scene.
transitionRecommendations.avoid: Do not label the stylized prologue as unrelated or reused without source evidence.

rejectOrDegradeConditions: Reject a proposed episode match if it lacks the same queen-to-2024-wife identity transfer.
Degrade boundary confidence if frame-accurate review places the montage-to-dialogue change outside 21-25s.
Keep the external subtype unknown_pending_review until source comparison establishes reused, unrelated, or mixed provenance.
Do not reject external-hook status merely because the same stylized characters or art direction continue into the episode.
